style: retro 16-bit pixel art, dark fantasy night palette, hard 1-pixel edges, clean dark outline, flat shading with at most 3 tones per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no glow, no soft shadows

tower.desc: a squat grey stone watchtower with battlements on top, mossy brick courses, one small glowing yellow window, and two thick gnarled wooden root-legs at the base that it walks on; slightly alive and characterful; front view with a gentle top-down 3/4 RPG perspective

zombie.desc: a small shambling green-skinned zombie with tattered clothes, arms stretched forward, tiny red eyes; front view with a gentle top-down 3/4 RPG perspective, facing right

xp.desc: a small faceted glowing blue crystal gem, bright highlight on the upper left

arrow.desc: a single wooden arrow pointing exactly to the right, steel arrowhead on the right end, feather fletching on the left end, drawn perfectly horizontal

ground.desc: a seamless tileable top-down ground tile of dark blue-grey night soil with a few tiny pebbles and one or two sparse dark-green grass tufts
